Touch would mean the grippers are making contact but not grasping.

In many of these VQA datasets, when the gripper is open and around the object but not closed, the label is "touch" if there's contact or "no contact" if not. The mouse being tilted/standing suggests the grippers are pushing against it, i.e., touching.
